from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from pathlib import Path
import os,re,tempfile
p=Path('/home/user/workspace/q4_ops.xlsx')
with ZipFile(p,'r') as zin:
    contents={n:zin.read(n) for n in zin.namelist()}
s=contents['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')
s=s.replace('dimension ref="A1:G14"','dimension ref="A1:F10"')
for r in range(6,11):
    s=s.replace(f'<c r="E{r}" s="0" t="n">',f'<c r="E{r}" s="2" t="n">')
# remove empty cell/rows left behind by editing; the original Revenue sheet was A:F only
s=re.sub(r'<c r="G10"[^>]*/>','',s)
s=re.sub(r'<row r="(?:11|12|13|14)"[^>]*>.*?</row>','',s)
contents['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml']=s.encode('utf-8')
tmp=p.with_suffix('.patched.xlsx')
with ZipFile(tmp,'w',ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for n,data in contents.items(): zout.writestr(n,data)
os.replace(tmp,p)
print('patched',p.stat().st_size)
with ZipFile(p) as z:
    s=z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode()
    print('dimension',re.search(r'<dimension ref="([^"]+)',s).group(1))
    print('money styles',[re.search(fr'<c r="E{i}" s="(\d+)"',s).group(1) for i in range(6,11)])
    print('stray cells',bool(re.search(r'<c r="G\d+"',s)))
    print('summary XML values')
    sm=z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet3.xml').decode()
    for r in (2,3,4): print(r,re.search(fr'<c r="B{r}".*?<v>(.*?)</v>',sm).group(1))
